description_excerpt: Job Description Get to Know the Team The VN/MM/KH Controllership team is responsible for ensuring accurate financial reporting, month-end close, statutory reporting, audit support, accounting governance and local compliance across the cluster. Vietnam is the largest and most complex market in the cluster. The team supports multiple entities, high-volume transactions, new product launches, business model changes, contract reviews, tax / audit matters, treasury-related processes and local statutory requirements. Myanmar and Cambodia are smaller markets but still require strong controllership…
